finding.economic_interpretation: A title that merely names the mandatory related-party fund-occupation review does not establish that an issuer actually suffered controller fund misappropriation. Treating the noun phrase as an adverse event confounds issuer risk with annual and interim reporting seasons.
finding.first_differing_semantic_state: The V1 title classifier emitted OPEN for generic titles such as related-party fund-occupation special explanations, audit explanations and independent-director opinions even when the title contained no explicit adverse predicate, non-operating occupation, remediation, repayment, investigation or risk-warning language.
finding.root_cause: The CONTROLLER_FUND_MISAPPROPRIATION OPEN rule required only an actor noun and a fund-occupation noun after a narrow routine-report exclusion. The exclusion omitted common special-explanation, special-report and independent-opinion boilerplate.
